Exchanges.Text:
Hi Gate team-c, good to see you.  
Sprint goal: Customers can pay by card and failed payments retry automatically, with 6 days left in the sprint.

Daniel, please give your update.  
First, is the summary page finished for story 3, then was task 19 done, and was task 15 finished? If task 19 slipped, did you flag it, and have you been able to help Maya Lin with bug 12?
Yesterday I finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two. Today I'm adding idempotency keys to payment requests. Nothing blocking me.

I’ve noted your commitment: I’m adding idempotency keys to payment requests today.
story 3, Customer payment plan summary page, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
Yes, it's on track. I'll pick the summary page back up as soon as the idempotency keys are in.

I’ve noted your commitment: I’ll pick the summary page back up as soon as the idempotency keys are in.

task 15, Add structured logging to gateway client, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
Structured logging is nearly done. I'll finish it today.
I’ve noted your commitment: I’ll finish it today.
Yes, that's right. That's everything from me.

Thanks, Daniel.  
I’m waiting for the next team member update. If anyone else has a turn, please go ahead.

Yesterday I reviewed the settlement schema. Today I'm continuing the settlement file validation. I'm blocked on bug 12. The sandbox gateway keeps timing out, and I need access to the platform team's staging gateway.
Sorry to jump in, Maya, but we hit the same gateway timeouts last sprint when we upgraded the TLS library, and it took us days to track down.
Right, I think the root cause was the connection pool settings, so we should compare the gateway configuration between sandbox and staging, and also check whether the sandbox certificate was rotated.
Let's take that offline, I’ll add this to the parking lot, and Maya, please carry on.
That's everything from me.
Who can help unblock this, Maya? You’re blocked on access to the platform team’s staging gateway to continue the settlement file validation today.
Daniel can help. He fixed the same gateway timeouts last sprint, so I'll pair with him on the staging access today.
Got it—let me quickly note your commitment and keep the focus on what’s already been said.
Maya, I’ve noted your commitment: I’ll pair with him on the staging access today.

Thanks, Maya.  
Admin, please go next and share your update, and is story 1 done? Also, is task 14 done?
Yesterday I finished the refund API tests.
Today I'm still working on the payment retry story.
No blockers.
Admin, I’ve noted your commitment: Keep working on the payment retry story today.
Yes, that's right.
That's everything from me.

Blocker: Maya Lin is blocked on access to the platform team’s staging gateway, and it’s carried over as offline discussion.  
There was also a side discussion with Daniel Park and Admin about prior gateway timeouts, and that’s parked for offline.  
Flagged item not covered: story 5, which is stale and missed commitment, and follow-ups for that and other open items will be handled in Teams.  
Thanks everyone, and follow-ups, including for anyone absent or who didn’t respond, will be coming in Teams.
